title: The constant-module unit is locally bijective
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, Λ a commutative ring, and M a Λ-module. Let F(M) be the constant module sheaf [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor]. Restrict its section modules along the ring sheafification unit Λ→underlineΛ(U) to obtain a presheaf P_M of Λ-modules. The unit η_M:const(M)→P_M is locally injective and locally surjective. Its underlying additive map is the ordinary additive sheafification unit, and its values are natural in M.

source.place: Tags 03CY and 093T: module sheafification unit and constant module sheaf construction.

proof.text: Construct the additive unit as toSheafify J of the constant additive presheaf underlying M. Use the generic local injectivity and local surjectivity instances for this unit. Restrict the scalar action of F(M)(U) along the ring unit at U; the module restriction maps give a Λ-module presheaf. The module-sheafification adjunction unit gives η_M as a linear natural transformation. Its underlying function is definitionally the additive unit, so their equalizer and image sieves agree. The additive unit instances therefore prove both properties for η_M. Naturality in M follows by applying the additive toSheafify_naturality equation to a constant section.
